answer: The Karst Algorithm mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to demonstrate a "gale" of reputation and resource commitments before participating in network consensus. By verifying the unique geological formations of an agent's "karst" - a decentralized, distributed ledger - and monitoring its activity patterns, the network can identify and penalize fake identities. A successful attack would be akin to a comet striking the network, causing irreparable damage to its integrity.
